_comment: Direct comparison to 'Financially Guided Deep Portfolio Optimization' (2026, arXiv:2605.28853) - a DEEP-LEARNING portfolio method on 50 S&P 500 stocks, expanding-window walk-forward, bid-ask costs, quarterly rebalancing. Their reported OOS 2022-2023: AttentionLSTM (Omega-CVaR-RiskParity) annualized Sharpe 0.29, cum +7.86%, vs S&P 500 Sharpe -0.02 / -4.52%. We run our Zgodovinski/Transformer/Ansambel pipelines on 50 large S&P 500 names over the SAME 2022-2023 OOS window, quarterly rebalance, 10bps costs, SPY benchmark. NB: they impose NO cardinality (soft allocation over 50); we add K=10 cardinality + box [0.02,0.30], so our comparison is CONSERVATIVE (more constrained) and at the protocol/metric level. This is the ML external head-to-head (complements classical Ramos).
